card.name: British spellings: metres, per cent, licence
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside British-spelled terms such as metres, centimetres, per cent, maths and licence, often right after a number.

modes.label: Numbers before metric units
modes.description: The last digit or the word before 'metres' or 'centimetres' in a measurement.
modes.example: 60 feet (1<<8>> metres) high on the northern side.

modes.label: Per cent
modes.description: A number or the word 'per' just before 'cent' written as two words.
modes.example: that risk might be 30<< per>> cent.''

modes.label: Licence and maths
modes.description: Words just before British spellings such as licence or maths.
